title: feat(nm2frm1spf): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along +e3 at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: +e3 1-step on the 'far-face' three-axis seed (third pair at (0,0,-1)/(0,1,-1)). Real content: this is the only seed variant that changes a probe frame — the adjacent +e_3 lock destroys the origin's split, which the note states correctly.
